runtime.command_template: python tools/run_pinmame_harness.py --library <libpinmame> --game taf_l7 --rom-path <vpinmame-roms> --work-dir <new-isolated-state> --handle-mechanics 0 --scenario tools/harness-scenarios/wpc-fliptronic/taf-switch-edges-control-53-57.json --dmd-dir <external-dmd-dir> --output <external-run.json>. Each set_switch holds one public level for 2 s; the snapshot after it records the ROM's T.1 display, its switch grid and the watched public switch levels.

diagnostic_snapshots.interpreted_text: SWITCH EDGES / T.1 / switch grid marks the closed matrix contacts 24, 53, 54, 55, 56, 57, 84, 85
diagnostic_snapshots.label: T.1 SWITCH EDGES started, every watched switch at public 0; the grid already marks the masked optos 53-57 and 84/85, whose public 0 is a closed matrix contact, so the grid shows raw closures

diagnostic_snapshots.interpreted_text: GRAVE "G" / T.1 LAST SW 41 / WHT-BRN GRN-YEL / switch grid marks the closed matrix contacts 24, 41, 53, 54, 55, 56, 57, 84, 85
diagnostic_snapshots.label: T.1 SWITCH EDGES two seconds after public 41 (Grave G, an ordinary leaf switch outside the mask) was set to 1

diagnostic_snapshots.interpreted_text: SWITCH EDGES / T.1 LAST SW 41 / WHT-BRN GRN-YEL / switch grid marks the closed matrix contacts 24, 53, 54, 55, 56, 57, 84, 85
diagnostic_snapshots.label: T.1 SWITCH EDGES two seconds after public 41 (Grave G, an ordinary leaf switch outside the mask) was set to 0

diagnostic_snapshots.interpreted_text: BOOKCASE OPTO 1 / T.1 LAST SW 53 / WHT-ORN GRN-BLK / switch grid marks the closed matrix contacts 24, 54, 55, 56, 57, 84, 85
diagnostic_snapshots.label: T.1 SWITCH EDGES two seconds after public 53 (Bookcase Opto 1, a manual-identified opto inverted by tafGameData's mask) was set to 1

diagnostic_snapshots.interpreted_text: SWITCH EDGES / T.1 LAST SW 53 / WHT-ORN GRN-BLK / switch grid marks the closed matrix contacts 24, 53, 54, 55, 56, 57, 84, 85
diagnostic_snapshots.label: T.1 SWITCH EDGES two seconds after public 53 (Bookcase Opto 1, a manual-identified opto inverted by tafGameData's mask) was set to 0

diagnostic_snapshots.interpreted_text: SWITCH EDGES / T.1 LAST SW 57 / WHT-VIO GRN-BLK / switch grid marks the closed matrix contacts 24, 53, 54, 55, 56, 57, 84, 85

named_action_observations.label: public 41 (Grave G, an ordinary leaf switch outside the mask) set to 1 inside T.1 SWITCH EDGES: the ROM's top line names it (GRAVE "G"), so the top line reads public 41 = 1 as active
public 41 (Grave G, an ordinary leaf switch outside the mask) set to 0 inside T.1 SWITCH EDGES: the ROM's top line returns to SWITCH EDGES

public 53 (Bookcase Opto 1, a manual-identified opto inverted by tafGameData's mask) set to 1 inside T.1 SWITCH EDGES: the ROM's top line names it (BOOKCASE OPTO 1), so the top line reads public 53 = 1 as active
public 53 (Bookcase Opto 1, a manual-identified opto inverted by tafGameData's mask) set to 0 inside T.1 SWITCH EDGES: the ROM's top line returns to SWITCH EDGES

public 57 (Bumper Lane Opto, a manual-identified opto inverted by tafGameData's mask) set to 1 inside T.1 SWITCH EDGES: the ROM's top line names it (BUMPER LANE OPTO), so the top line reads public 57 = 1 as active
public 57 (Bumper Lane Opto, a manual-identified opto inverted by tafGameData's mask) set to 0 inside T.1 SWITCH EDGES: the ROM's top line returns to SWITCH EDGES
